NEW YORK - NYC, IVO Liberty Island - Gathering of Vessels
Mariners are advised that a gathering of vessels is scheduled to occur in the vicinity of Liberty Island on October 14, 2026, between 6:45 p.m. and 7:15 p.m. Approximately 8 vessels of various sizes, from 80ft passenger vessels, to a 210ft yacht, in the waters of Liberty Island within approximate position 40°‎ 41' 195"N, 074°‎ 02' 530"W. Mariners are requested to transit at low wake speeds and navigate with caution when in the vicinity of the event. Interested mariners may contact the Event Coordinator via telephone at 347-239-7455
CANCEL AT//142315Z OCT 26//

items.text:
1. NARRATIVE: APPROXIMATELY A SWIM OF 40 SWIMMERS WILL SWIM FROM SOUTH COVE, MANHATTAN TO LIBERTY ISLAND AND LIBERTY ISLAND TO SOUTH COVE WILL BE HELD ON THE HUDSON RIVER ON SEPTEMBER 19, 2026. 
2. NEW YORK - HUDSON RIVER - A SWIM WILL TAKE PLACE BETWEEN 10:30 A.M TO 3:00 P.M ON SEPTEMBER 19, 2026. APPROXIMATELY 40 SWIMMERS WILL SWIM FROM SOUTH COVE, MANHATTAN TO LIBERTY ISLAND AND THEN LIBERTY ISLAND TO SOUTH COVE, MANHATTAN. THE FIRST GROUP OF SWIMMERS WILL ENTER THE WATER FROM BOATS NEAR SOUTH COVE, MANHATTAN AND WILL TRANSIT SOUTH DOWN THE SHORE OF NEW JERSEY TO LIBERTY ISLAND. THE SECOND GROUP OF SWIMMERS WILL START NEAR LIBERTY ISLAND, PROCEED NORTH ALONG THE SHORLELINE OF NEW JERSEY AND FINISH AT SOUTH COVE, MANHATTAN. ALL CONCERNED TRAFFIC MAY CONTACT THE EVENT COORDINATOR ON CH 6 VHF-FM.
3. SECNY BROADCAST 30 MINUTES PRIOR TO EVENT AND EVERY 60 MINUTES UNTIL COMPLETION.

items.text:

items.area: BOSTON HARBOR AND CAPE COD CANAL/RIGHT WHALE SLOW ZONE
items.text:
QUOTE. MARINERS OPERATING IN AND AROUND BOSTON HARBOR AND CAPE COD CANAL ARE URGED TO KEEP A LOOKOUT FOR ENDANGERED RIGHT WHALES. RIGHT WHALE SIGHTINGS HAVE BEEN CONSISTENT IN THE AREA. 
FEDERAL LAW PROHIBITS ALL VESSELS FROM APPROACHING WITHIN 500 YARDS OF A RIGHT WHALE AND REQUIRES MOST VESSELS 65 FEET OR GREATER IN LENGTH TO OPERATE AT 10 KNOTS OR LESS IN SEASONAL MANAGEMENT AREAS, INCLUDING CAPE COD BAY. MASSACHUSETTS STATE REGULATIONS ARE ALSO CURRENTLY IN EFFECT, REQUIRING MOST VESSELS UNDER 65 FEET TO GO 10 KNOTS OR LESS IN CAPE COD BAY. PLEASE REPORT ALL RIGHT WHALE SIGHTINGS TO 866-755-NOAA OR TO THE COAST GUARD VIA CHANNEL 16. UNQUOTE.
CANCEL AT//181848Z APR 25//

FROM 38-48-00N/068-26-00W
TO 41-06-00N/064-40-00W
TO 40-19-00N/063-55-00W
TO 38-03-00N/067-41-00W TO BEGINNING.
THIS HAZARD AREA IS IN EFFECT DURING THE FOLLOWING DATES AND TIME:
PRIMARY: 051442Z JUN 2024 TO 051624Z JUN 2024.
SECONDARY: 061419Z JUN 2024 TO 061601Z JUN 2024.
TERTIARY: 091308Z JUN 2024 TO 091450Z JUN 2024.
FOLLOWING THE LAUNCH OF ATLAS V CFT, A COMMON CORE BOOSTER, ASCENT COVER, AEROSKIRT, AND POD COVER, ARE EXPECTED TO SEPARATE FROM THE MAIN LAUNCH VEHICLE, DESCEND, AND SPLASH DOWN INSIDE THE ABOVE HAZARD AREA. HAZARDS FROM ROCKET LAUNCH ACTIVITIES MAY INCLUDE FREE FALLING DEBRIS AND/OR DESCENDING VEHICLES OR VEHICLE COMPONENTS UNDER VARIOUS MEANS OF CONTROL. MARINERS ARE URGED TO AVOID WATERS WITHIN ROCKET FLIGHT TRAJECTORIES/HAZARD AREAS DURING LAUNCH WINDOWS AS DETAILED ABOVE.

items.area: EAST OF BARNEGAT INLET
items.text:
NOAA WEATHER BUOY 44025 HAS BROKEN FREE FROM ITS MOORING AND IS CURRENTLY ADRIFT SOUTH OF THE AMBROSE TO NANTUCKET SAFETY FAIRWAY, IN POSITION 39-45-56.5N, 073-55-26.0W, APPROXIMATELY 8 NAUTICAL MILES EAST OF THE ENTRANCE TO BARNEGAT INLET AND DRIFTING TO THE SOUTH. MARINERS ARE ADVISED TO TRANSIT THE AREA WITH EXTREME CAUTION AND REPORT ANY SIGHTINGS TO THE NEAREST COAST GUARD UNIT. UPDATED INFORMATION AND THE LATEST POSITION CAN BE FOUND ON NOAA'S NATIONAL DATA BUOY CENTER (NDBC) WEBSITE. 
CANCEL AT//121813Z APR 24//
